description.value: Belgian Fries is a bar and restaurant on Vancouver's busy Commercial Drive, serving Belgian-style fries and Canadian comfort food since 1998. The menu anchors on hand-cut fries and 18 varieties of poutine, alongside burgers, fish and chips, and sandwiches. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, and the restaurant offers a pickup/takeout option for cyclists on the move.
